notes: Marketing phase 5. Settings → Import → 'Marketing — Sample Dispatch Excel': choose Sample_Dispatch.xlsm (or a file with only the DATA sheet) to bring the enquiries, samples, call history and planned calls into Mineral Saathi, with a grade-matching table, a check report and a list of things to check by hand; it can be run again during the side-by-side trial. Marketing Reports: samples by month, grade and courier, enquiries by state, pending and late calls, enquiries that became buyers, each with Export. Make Buyer: copies an enquiry into Master → Buyer B2B (or links it to a buyer already there).
